properties.description: Phase 3 - replaces the post-run BTEQ row-count block of orchestration/run_full_pipeline.sh. Counts the three staging tables and four data products, fails the run when a threshold is breached, and writes the run-log entry that replaces ETL_RUN_LOG.

text.value: @concat('WITH COUNTS AS (', 'SELECT ''STG_CUSTOMER_360'' AS TABLE_NAME, ''STAGING'' AS LAYER, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseStaging, '.STAGING.STG_CUSTOMER_360 UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''STG_TXN_SUMMARY'', ''STAGING'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseStaging, '.STAGING.STG_TXN_SUMMARY UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''STG_RISK_FACTORS'', ''STAGING'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseStaging, '.STAGING.STG_RISK_FACTORS UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS'', ''PRODUCT'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseProducts, '.DATA_PRODUCTS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENTS UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''TRANSACTION_ANALYTICS'', ''PRODUCT'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseProducts, '.DATA_PRODUCTS.TRANSACTION_ANALYTICS UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''CUSTOMER_RISK_SCORES'', ''PRODUCT'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseProducts, '.DATA_PRODUCTS.CUSTOMER_RISK_SCORES UNION ALL ', 'SELECT ''CUSTOMER_MASTER_PROFILE'', ''PRODUCT'', COUNT(*) FROM ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseProducts, '.DATA_PRODUCTS.CUSTOMER_MASTER_PROFILE', '), CHECKED AS (SELECT TABLE_NAME, ROW_COUNT, CASE WHEN LAYER = ''STAGING'' THEN ', string(pipeline().parameters.minRowsStaging), ' ELSE ', string(pipeline().parameters.minRowsProducts), ' END AS MIN_ROWS FROM COUNTS) ', 'SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROW_COUNT < MIN_ROWS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BREACH_COUNT, ', 'LISTAGG(TABLE_NAME || ''='' || TO_VARCHAR(ROW_COUNT) || ''/'' || TO_VARCHAR(MIN_ROWS), ''; '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TABLE_NAME) AS DETAIL FROM CHECKED')

message.value: @concat('Post-run row-count validation failed for run ', pipeline().parameters.runId, ' in ', pipeline().parameters.environment, '. Counts (actual/minimum): ', string(activity('CheckRowCounts').output.resultSets[0].rows[0].DETAIL))

text.value: @concat('INSERT INTO ', pipeline().parameters.snowflakeDatabaseStaging, '.OPS.PIPELINE_RUN_LOG (RUN_ID, PIPELINE_NAME, ENVIRONMENT, STEP_NAME, STATUS, DETAIL, LOG_TS) SELECT ''', pipeline().parameters.runId, ''', ''pl_retail_banking_analytics'', ''', pipeline().parameters.environment, ''', ''POST_RUN_VALIDATION'', ''SUCCEEDED'', ''staging_skipped=', string(pipeline().parameters.skipStaging), ' analytics_skipped=', string(pipeline().parameters.skipAnalytics), ' counts=', string(activity('CheckRowCounts').output.resultSets[0].rows[0].DETAIL), ''', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()')
